coverage_rationale: Probes cover: contract-graph structural integrity (probe 1), near-neighbor exclusion and prov-uniqueness (probe 2), non-goal and anti-fabrication enforcement (probe 3), and universal-concern coverage completeness (probe 4). Together they span the four primary failure modes a file-bucket report generator would exhibit relative to a semantic-responsibility decomposition.
discrimination_rate: 4/4 probes set discrimination_passed=true, conditioned on deterministic gate or probe rubric rejection of the planted bad decomposition pattern
independence_statement: Builder model claude-sonnet-4-6 did not participate in the primary decomposition by claude-opus-4-8. Probes were constructed solely from the project packet summary and primary decomposition provided in this prompt, without access to the primary decomposer's internal reasoning, chain-of-thought, or intermediate outputs.
rationale: Four probes were designed to discriminate semantic-responsibility decomposition from a fluent file-bucket report. Probe 1 (worker-mcp-distinct-endpoints) tests the contract directed-edge invariant that from_component_id != to_component_id; a directory-grouping generator merging worker/ files breaks this invariant deterministically. Probe 2 (persona-corpus-distinct-from-machine-data) tests near-neighbor exclusion gate enforcement for nn:persona-in-data and prov-uniqueness; a consumer-role classifier merging prose and JSON triggers both checks. Probe 3 (build-pipeline-source-only-no-dist) tests non-goal enforcement and anti-fabrication prov anchoring together; a pipeline-owns-output generator claims dist/ nodes that have no packet prov, failing both gates. Probe 4 (anti-fabrication-concern-is-universal) tests universal-concern coverage across all seven components; a generator skipping cross-cutting-concern modeling or scoping concerns conditionally leaves most components uncovered and trips the set-difference gate. All probes use only IDs present in the supplied decomposition packet; no graph node IDs were invented.
